title: Right Drug, Right Dose, Right Time - Using Genomic Data to Individualize Treatment
brief_summary: This study is being done to better understand how genetic information related to drug dosing and use can affect medical care of patients. By doing this study, the investigators are developing and improving ways to incorporate information about drug related genetic variants into the medical record.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Biobank participants who receive the majority of their care at Mayo Clinic based on EHR length and depth.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not in the Mayo Clinic Biobank. Do not receive the majority of their care at a Mayo Clinic site.
